comparison.objective: Compress and plug a spring wound-drain reservoir; candidate separates industrial solids.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained compression and plug insertion while preserving vacuum state versus pouring and bridge-clearing screen motion.
comparison.success_condition: Reservoir remains compressed and sealed after release versus ≥98% media recovery and full washer retention.
comparison.reason: Compression/sealing is unrelated to size-selective screening.
